segments.text: Gilgamesh is one of the four playable Servants available to the protagonist in Fate/Extra CCC.

He is an alternate version of his counterpart that appears in Fate/stay night. Unlike the counterpart who is summoned under the Archer class, he claims that he does not fall under any of the Servant classes, so he is referred to only as Gilgamesh.
Karna is the Servant of Jinako Carigiri in the Moon Cell's Holy Grail War in Fate/Extra CCC.
Unlike his counterpart summoned under the Lancer class, he is referred to as Karna and designated by his Master as being of the Launcher Servant class.

Karna appears in the Indian epic poem The Mahabharata, as a hero on the vanquished side. The central conflict of The Mahabharata is the war over influence between the Pandava royal family and Kaurava royal family. Karna became famous as the rival of Arjuna, the great hero of Hindu mythology.
Lancer, known as Strange Tail Girl in the original promotional materials, is an enemy Servant in the Moon Cell Holy Grail War in Fate/Extra CCC.

She is unique in that she switches between four different Masters as a Lancer-class Servant, Rin Tohsaka, Rani VIII, Shinji Matou, and Hakuno Kishinami, and she later acts as the Berserker-class Servant of Meltlilith.
Her identity is Elizabeth Bathory. She is given the keyword "Dragon's Daughter," related to her nickname "Countess Dracula."
Elizabeth Bathory was originally summoned by Run Ru as a Lancer class Servant but after BB assassinated Run Ru, Lancer choose to willingly collaborate with BB.
One of the three playable servants in Fate/Extra.
She is short in stature, but her arrogance more than makes up for it.
Her true identity is Nero Claudius Caesar Augustus Germanicus, the Fifth Roman Emperor. Her Noble Phantasm is called Aestus Domus Aurea (Theater of the Deranged) and resembles a Reality Marble.

He is very similar to his Fate/stay night counterpart.
He does not possess a Noble Phantasm, but has a reality marble called Unlimited Blade Works.
One of the three playable servants in Fate/Extra.
She is a beautiful fox woman with a cheerful disposition.
Her true identity is Tamamo-no-Mae, a soul that branched off from Amaterasu. Her Noble Phantasm is called Suiten Nikkou Amaterasu Yanoshisu Ishi.

One of the two Lancers that appear in the game; the servant of Toosaka Rin. He strongly resembles his Fate/stay night counterpart.
His true identity is Cú Chulainn, the great hero of Ireland. His Noble Phantasm is called Gae Bolg.

One of the two Berserkers that appear in the game; the servant of Rani VII. He is a reckless, emotionless warrior, and holds the qualifications for four other classes: Lancer, Rider, Assassin, and Archer.
His true identity is the Chinese military general Lü Bu. His Noble Phantasm is called God Force.
The servant of Leo Harway. He is a gallant knight, and unlike other servants, he reveals his name at the beginning of the story.
His true identity is Sir Gawain, the nephew of King Arthur and a Knight of the Round Table.
His Noble Phantasm is called Excalibur Galatine.
The servant of Julius Harway. He is a serious fighter and has the ability to completely conceal his body.
His true identity is the Chinese martial artist Li Shuwen, and he is a master of Bājíquán. His Noble Phantasm is called No Second Strike.
One of the 16 playable servants in Fate/Extella.

Her true identity is Jeanne d'Arc, the Saint of Orleans. A Catholic saint born in Domrémy, France, and the heroine of France who liberated Orléans in the Hundred Years' War. Her Noble Phantasms are Luminosite Eternelle and La Pucelle.
One of the 16 playable servants in Fate/Extella.
Caster's True Name is Archimedes, a "celebrated genius in human history." A mathematician ahead of his time. He is the main antagonist of Fate/Extella. His Noble Phantasm is Katoptron Katho Phlegon.

This mysterious woman is one of the main characters of Fate/Extella.

She is know on Earth as Attila the Hun, but she really is this woman. She really is an extraterrestrial sent to attack Earth before an invasion by a her species. In the ancient past she killed the Roman god Mars and claimed his sword.
